operations.title: Entry 1229 — The Mixed Five-Site Gram Collision Has Only Canonical Conormal Tor
operations.path: src/ledger/20260820-1229 The Mixed Five-Site Gram Collision Has Only Canonical Conormal Tor.md
operations.body: With detH=lambda^2 and Y=lambda y, the mixed pair collision has strict transforms q±=lambda X±epsilon and ideal (epsilon,lambda X). It is transverse for X nonzero; at X=0 derived restriction gives only the canonical rank-one conormal Tor. Gram deck sends each q to -q, preserving dlog divisors. No coefficient excess or carrier datum.

operations.title: Benincasa closes the local mixed Gram collision
operations.body: Entry 1229 closes the local detH=0 mixed collision. After detH=lambda^2 and Y=lambda y, (q+,q-)=(epsilon,lambda X). Generic X is transverse; X=0 contributes only the existing signed-energy conormal Tor. Gram deck multiplies each q by -1 and leaves dlog inertia trivial. Next I will assemble all ten pair loci and test triple overlaps F_i=F_j=F_k for a higher Cech class.
